jsonLd.headline: Building a Cohesive Social Media Design System: Beyond Generic Canva Templates
jsonLd.name: Building a Cohesive Social Media Design System: Beyond Generic Canva Templates
jsonLd.description: Why template fatigue is killing your social media reach. Learn how to architect a modular social design system with consistent typography scales, multi-slide carousels, and motion graphics that build recognizable brand equity.

itemListElement.name: Building a Cohesive Social Media Design System: Beyond Generic Canva Templates

mainEntity.name: Why are multi-slide carousels more effective than single image posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carousels offer multiple opportunities for user interaction. If a user does not engage with slide 1, the Instagram algorithm frequently re-serves the post displaying slide 2, effectively doubling your impressions without additional ad spend.

mainEntity.name: How many social media posts should a brand publish per week?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality vastly outperforms spammy quantity. For most B2B and luxury brands, 3 to 4 deeply valuable, aesthetically immaculate posts per week (combining 2 carousels and 2 high-retention reels) drives substantially higher revenue than daily generic posts.

mainEntity.name: How does Lucie Creatives ensure social media graphics match brand guidelines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every asset is engineered inside a centralized Figma design system where color tokens, typography styles, and margins are locked. Assets undergo senior art director review prior to scheduled publishing.
